purpose: Teach: 乗り込む/やって来る/得よ/上質/ニュースレター/上乗せ/不可避/初旬

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究、本気で、絶対、新分野に、絶対、乗り込む覚悟、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren, I need you to commit fully—really commit—to diving into this new research area. This is serious.
lines.style: Measured authority. Direct eye contact. Weight behind each phrase, but not unkind. Expectation tempered with belief in him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新しい指導教官、本気で、絶対、研究室に、絶対、やって来る予定です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I have a new advisor lined up, and I'm going in with full commitment. Thank you for this opportunity.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Slightly faster cadence than normal—eager to prove himself. Respectful but not deferential. Steady gaze.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究、本気で、絶対、最大の成果を、絶対、得ようと、絶対、努めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Good. Push for maximum impact with your results. This is the moment where that matters most. I'm counting on it.
lines.style: Firm. A beat of pause after 'Good' to let it land. The tone shifts from request to expectation. Slightly lower register. Not a question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。上質な、本気で、絶対、論文を、絶対、目指してまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm aiming for rigorous, publishable work. I appreciate your confidence in me.
lines.style: Respectful, direct. No hesitation. Speaks with the quiet precision of someone who means every word. Maintains composure despite the weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究室の、本気で、絶対、ニュースレター、絶対、若手に、絶対、書かせろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And get the junior researchers writing for the lab newsletter. Fresh perspective. That matters.
lines.style: Almost conversational after the heaviness. Practical instruction layered with subtle mentorship. Quick tempo. It's not negotiable but it's collaborative.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。査読、本気で、絶対、上乗せ、絶対、修正、絶対、進めてまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. I'll be managing the peer review process and revisions carefully. Moving forward steadily.
lines.style: Assured but not proud. Shows he's heard the full scope. Efficient delivery—he's already thinking three steps ahead. Calm baseline.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 時代の流れ、本気で、絶対、不可避、絶対、君も、研究方法、絶対、刷新しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The field is shifting. You know that. Your methods need to shift with it. Don't get comfortable with how things were.
lines.style: Slight weight of warning, but wrapped in reason not rebuke. Leans forward slightly. Lower, deliberate pace. The voice of experience.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。来月初旬、本気で、絶対、学会発表、絶対、予定、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I have a conference presentation scheduled for early next month. I'm ready to show what we're building.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. The fatigue of preparation is there but controlled. Slight lift at the end—he's stating a fact, not asking permission. Pride without arrogance.
